description: Set clump CFD extra variables. The extra variable can be of any type and is associated with the index i as if stored in an array.

examples.description: Store a value in extra slot 1

notes: On 7.00 and 9.8 the command is accepted and echoes success, but the value is not retrievable afterwards: clump.cfd.extra reads 0 and 'clump cfd list extra' shows nothing. On 6.00 the value persists.
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC3D 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (state grade): on 6.00 the value reads back exactly via clump.cfd.extra; on 7.00 and 9.8 the command is accepted but the stored value is lost (reads 0) - treat it as unreliable there.
